title: Extraction and ONT MinION Library Preparation of uHMW gDNA
author: Kaylee S. Herzog
materials: Use a new NEB Monarch Pestle NEB Catalog #T3002-1 to grind and crush the tissue in the tube. Keep the pestle in the tube
Flick to mix, then spin down briefly
Defrost the needed NEB DNA and End Repair reagents on ice (see Part 3 Step 38)
Keep master mix on ice after mixing
Keep titrated wash mix on ice after vortexing

steps.title: Set dry bath to 55 °C
steps.instruction: Program the dry bath to 55 °C and allow it to equilibrate before use.

steps.title: Prepare tissue‑lysis master mix
steps.instruction: In a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube combine 95 µL Zymo DNA Elution Buffer (Catalog #D3004-4-1), 95 µL Zymo Biofluid & Solid Tissue Buffer (Catalog #D4081-3-25), and 10 µL Zymo Proteinase K (Catalog #D3001-2-20). Vortex gently, spin down, and keep the tube on ice.

steps.title: Add tissue to tube
steps.instruction: Using a new pipette tip or sterilized forceps, transfer one whole worm (or a piece of tissue) directly from the preservative into the tube, minimizing the amount of preservative liquid transferred.

steps.title: Add master mix and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the master mix to the tube containing tissue, grind with a pestle until homogenized, wipe the pestle on the tube walls, close the tube, invert/flick gently, and spin briefly to collect liquid.

steps.title: Incubate lysate at 55 °C
steps.instruction: Place the tube in the dry bath at 55 °C for 2 h 30 min up to overnight until tissue solubilizes. Flick the tube every 20 min, spin briefly each time. If visible tissue remains, centrifuge 1 min at ≥10 000 × g, transfer the clear supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube, and discard the pellet.

steps.title: Set dry bath to 37 °C
steps.instruction: Program the dry bath to 37 °C and allow it to equilibrate.

steps.title: Add MagBinding buffer and beads (first binding)
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Zymo Quick‑DNA™ MagBinding Buffer (Catalog #D4077-1-150) to each lysate, flick to mix, spin briefly. Then add 33 µL Zymo MagBinding Beads (Catalog #D4100-2-6); vortex the bead suspension before dispensing. Mix on a low‑speed rotator for 2 h at room temperature, then spin briefly.

steps.title: Separate beads and discard supernatant (first wash)
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic stand until beads collect, then slowly aspirate and discard the supernatant while keeping beads on the magnet.

steps.title: Wash beads with MagBinding buffer (first)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Zymo Quick‑DNA™ MagBinding Buffer (Catalog #D4077-1-150), flick to mix, then mix on a low‑speed rotator for 20 min at room temperature. Spin briefly before the next step.

steps.title: Separate beads and discard supernatant (second wash)
steps.instruction: Place tubes on the magnetic stand, allow beads to collect, then aspirate and discard the supernatant as before.

steps.title: Pre‑wash beads with DNA Pre‑Wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Zymo DNA Pre‑Wash Buffer (Catalog #D3004-5-250), place on magnet, and discard the supernatant while keeping beads on the magnet.

steps.title: First g‑DNA Wash and transfer
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL Zymo g‑DNA Wash Buffer (Catalog #D3004-2-200). Transfer the entire contents (liquid + beads) to a new clean 1.5 mL tube to avoid lid‑associated salts. Place on magnetic stand, let beads collect, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Second g‑DNA Wash and transfer
steps.instruction: Add another 900 µL Zymo g‑DNA Wash Buffer (Catalog #D3004-2-200) to the tube from the previous step, place on magnetic stand, let beads collect, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: With tubes still on the magnet, use a P10 pipette to remove any residual liquid. Air‑dry beads for up to 20 min, checking frequently; beads change from glossy black (wet) to matte black/brown (dry). Do not over‑dry.

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Zymo DNA Elution Buffer (Catalog #D3004-4-50). If downstream Qubit/TapeStation is planned, add 52 µL Elution Buffer (Catalog #D3004-4-10) instead. Flick gently several times, spin briefly, then incubate at 37 °C for 2 h, flicking every 20 min and briefly spinning to recollect liquid. After incubation, place tubes on bench at room temperature overnight.

steps.title: Collect eluate and store DNA
steps.instruction: After the overnight incubation, place tubes on a magnetic stand, let beads collect, and transfer the supernatant (eluted gDNA) to a new 1.5 mL tube. Store DNA at 4 °C or –20 °C. If the yield is low, optionally resuspend the beads in 20 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Quantify extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Use 1 µL of the eluate for Qubit fluorometric quantification.

steps.title: Assess fragment size
steps.instruction: Use 1 µL of the eluate for TapeStation fragment‑size analysis.

steps.title: Set dry bath to 65 °C
steps.instruction: Program the dry bath to 65 °C and allow it to equilibrate.

steps.title: Prepare DNA repair & end‑prep master mix
steps.instruction: In a clean 0.2 mL PCR tube combine 3.5 µL NEBNext® FFPE DNA Repair Buffer (Catalog #E7180S), 2 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix (Catalog #M6630L), 3.5 µL NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer (Catalog #E7647), and 3 µL NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (Catalog #E7646). Vortex 10–20 times between each addition to mix.

steps.title: Add repair mix to purified DNA
steps.instruction: Add 12 µL of the master mix to each 1.5 mL tube containing the purified uHMW gDNA, flick gently, and spin down to collect liquid.

steps.title: Incubate repair and end‑prep
steps.instruction: Incubate 10 min at room temperature, then 10 min at 65 °C in the dry bath.

steps.title: Bind repaired DNA to MagBinding beads
steps.instruction: Add 4 volumes of Zymo DNA MagBinding Buffer (Catalog #D4012-1-50) to each sample (e.g., 200 µL for 50 µL DNA), mix by flicking/inverting. Spin briefly, then add 20 µL Zymo MagBinding Beads (Catalog #D4100-5-2); vortex beads before dispensing. Mix on a low‑speed rotator for 1 min 30 sec at room temperature.

steps.title: Pellet beads and discard supernatant (first wash)
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic stand for 1–2 min until the supernatant is clear, then pipette off and discard the supernatant while beads remain on the magnet.

steps.title: Wash beads with DNA Wash Buffer (first)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Zymo DNA Wash Buffer (Catalog #D4003-2-24), remove tubes from the magnet, flick/invert to mix, spin briefly, return to magnetic stand, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash beads with DNA Wash Buffer (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step with another 500 µL of Zymo DNA Wash Buffer (Catalog #D4003-2-24).

steps.title: Air‑dry beads after washes
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the bead pellet for 10 min. Do not over‑dry; complete removal of residual buffer is required for optimal elution.

steps.title: Elute repaired DNA
steps.instruction: Add 52 µL Zymo DNA Elution Buffer (Catalog #D3004-4-10). Manually flick/invert for 10–20 min (manual agitation required because volume is small), spin briefly, place tubes on magnetic stand for 1–2 min, then retain the 52 µL eluate in a new clean 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Quantify repaired DNA
steps.instruction: Use 1 µL of the 52 µL eluate for Qubit fluorometric quantification.

steps.title: Prepare ligation reagents
steps.instruction: Remove AMPure XP Beads (Catalog #A63880) from 4 °C storage and let them reach room temperature. Spin down the Ligation Adaptor (LA) (ONT) and Quick T4 DNA Ligase (NEB, Catalog #E7180S) and keep on ice. Thaw ONT Ligation Buffer (LNB), Elution Buffer (EB), Short Fragment Buffer (SFB), and Long Fragment Buffer (LFB) at room temperature, spin down, vortex, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Make adaptor master mix per sample
steps.instruction: In a clean 1.5 mL tube add, in order, 25 µL Ligation Adaptor (ONT), 10 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase, and 5 µL Ligation Adaptor (ONT). Pipette 10–20 times between each addition to mix.

steps.title: Prepare 1:3 SFB:LFB wash mix
steps.instruction: In a clean 1.5 mL tube combine 125 µL Short Fragment Buffer (SFB, ONT) with 375 µL Long Fragment Buffer (LFB, ONT); vortex to mix. (Optional: for high‑input samples use 1:5 ratio or undiluted LFB.)

steps.title: Ligate adaptors to repaired DNA
steps.instruction: Pipette 40 µL of the adaptor master mix (from the previous step) directly into the tube containing the 52 µL repaired DNA, flick gently, and spin down to collect liquid.

steps.title: Incubate ligation reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate 15 min at room temperature. If the bead‑based purification steps from the second half of Part 3 were omitted, limit incubation to 10 min.

steps.title: Bind library to AMPure XP beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP Beads (Catalog #A63880) by vortexing. Add 0.4× the total reaction volume (e.g., 35.6 µL for an 89 µL input) to each sample, flick to mix. Beads settle quickly; vortex before each dispensing.

steps.title: Mix library‑bead suspension
steps.instruction: Mix on a low‑speed rotator for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Pellet beads and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic stand for 1–2 min until the supernatant is clear, then pipette off and discard the supernatant while beads remain on the magnet.

steps.title: Wash beads with SFB:LFB (first)
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of the 1:3 SFB:LFB wash mix, flick to resuspend beads, spin briefly, return to magnetic rack, allow beads to pellet, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash beads with SFB:LFB (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous wash with another 250 µL of the 1:3 SFB:LFB mix.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads after washes
steps.instruction: Air‑dry beads for 30 s to 2 min. Do not let the pellet crack; over‑drying reduces yield.

steps.title: Elute prepared library
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnetic stand, add 15 µL ONT Elution Buffer (EB), spin briefly, then incubate in a dry bath at 37 °C for 2 h, flicking every 20 min and briefly spinning to recollect liquid.

steps.title: Overnight incubation of library eluate
steps.instruction: After the 2 h incubation, place tubes on the bench at room temperature and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Collect final library eluate
steps.instruction: After the overnight incubation, place tubes on a magnetic stand until beads pellet and the eluate is clear (≥1 min). Transfer the 15 µL supernatant (prepared library) to a new clean 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Quantify final library
steps.instruction: Use 1 µL of the 15 µL library for Qubit fluorometric quantification. Store the library on ice or at 4 °C for same‑day sequencing, or at –20 °C for longer‑term storage.

steps.title: Assess library fragment size
steps.instruction: Use 1 µL of the final library for TapeStation fragment‑size analysis. Note: sequencing adaptors ligated in the next section affect TapeStation validity, so this assessment should be performed after DNA repair and end‑preparation.
